create_file_checkpoint_storage: create a FileCheckpointStorage instance to manage HDF5 checkpoint files in a directory path
save_entity_partition: save entity partition embeddings and optimizer state to an HDF5 checkpoint file
load_entity_partition: load entity partition embeddings and optimizer state from an HDF5 checkpoint file
save_model: save the model state dict and optimizer state to an HDF5 model checkpoint file
load_model: load the model state dict and optimizer state from an HDF5 model checkpoint file
